from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EquityRecord(BaseModel):
    """A specific equity measurement reported in a single financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the report belongs to")
    fiscal_year_end: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year end date reported (e.g. '2022', 'Dec 31, 2022')")
    reporting_metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label used in the text (e.g. 'Total Stockholders’ Equity')")
    reported_amount: str | None = Field(description="The reported amount string (e.g. '$191,921,043' or '$165.0 million')")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the amount (e.g. 'millions', 'thousands', 'dollars')")
    statement_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of statement this came from (e.g. 'Consolidated Balance Sheets')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    equity_records: list[EquityRecord]
